legalName: Petition to Expunge under G.L. c. 276, §§ 100F, 100G and 100H (Massachusetts Probation Service)
routeSelectionNote: The form's three boxes — § 100F, § 100G and § 100H — are NOT a route election this build makes. This family covers all three sections: the route is time-based expungement, and the two route keys it carries are the Commissioner's certification stage and the court's determination stage, not a choice between statutes. Which of the three boxes applies follows from what the participant's own record shows — a delinquency adjudication, an adult conviction, or a non-adjudication or non-conviction — and the platform has not seen it. The box is therefore declared required-before-filing with routeDetermined false, and no box is marked.
